Once all of its [[Shield Health]] is depleted, its [[Defense]] gained from the forcefield is removed alongside [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Aggro]], if it has it. }} ==Description== The '''Slow King''' is a high health enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has high health and [[Shield Health]], alongside a high amount of [[Defense]]. When it spawns in, it has a forcefield around itself which grants it 60% [[Defense]]. Once all of its [[Shield Health]] is depleted, the forcefield will disappear, removing the [[Defense]], and if the '''Slow King''' has it, the [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Aggro]] it has. ==Logbook Description== "''Where a realm falls, its king is not always quick enough to fall with it. The Slow King sat in the ruins of their realm after trying to save their people. As the Void bloomed across the landscape and everything they had built came crumbling down, the Slow King was the last to accept defeat. It was not until they were recognized by Void Caster that they could continue on beside their people, who were now Souls for the Void.''" ==Appearance== The '''Slow King''' has a white body with a large hole in its face. It wears a purple king's robe, black pants, gold armbands, a purple cape, a gold crown and a glowing purple necklace. When initially spawning in, it has a purple forcefield around it which disappears when its [[Shield Health]] is depleted. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Juggernaut]], [[Turret]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Kingpin]] can be used against this. *Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Golden Demoman]] ignore the '''Slow King's''' [[Defense]], allowing them to take out its shield much earlier, while also handling the hordes they often appear in. **High DPS towers are recommended against the '''Slow King''' once its shield is broken. Additionally, it also loses its [[Freeze Immunity]], though it retains its [[Stun Immunity]]. *Towers that melt [[Defense]] such as the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can greatly weaken groups of '''Slow Kings'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Slow King''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} SlowKingCA.png|'''Slow King''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernSlowKingIconIG.png|'''Slow King''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The modern '''Slow King''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Slow King''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Void Keeper]]|Wave 36|[[Soul]] & Slow King|Wave 37|[[Void Cultist]]|Wave 38}} {{Voidcore|[[Elite Void Rusher]]|Wave 37|Slow King|Wave 38|[[Speedy King]]|Wave 39}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
